title: Accessibility
description: Tools and practices that help everyone access content on the Office of the Royal Society website

blocks.heading: Accessibility
blocks.lead: Tools and practices that help everyone access content on the Office of the Royal Society website

blocks.heading: Accessibility tools
blocks.intro: Use the “Accessibility” button at the bottom right of every page to open these tools

items.title: Adjust text size
items.body: Increase, decrease or reset the text size of the whole page

items.title: High contrast colors
items.body: Switch to strongly contrasting background and text colours

items.title: Easy reading mode
items.body: Increase line and letter spacing for easier reading

blocks.heading: Keyboard and screen reader use
paragraphs: Press Tab at the top of a page to use the “Skip to main content” link. All menus and buttons work with the keyboard.
Images have text descriptions, and links that open in a new tab are announced to screen readers.
